塔羅系列 哲思系列

The Moon: Illusion, intuition, insecurity, anxiety, subconscious.
月亮：幻象、直覺、不安、焦慮、潛意識。

《Lunasim / 顛月論》

When Mercury is retrograde, capture a sunset scene.
The robin will stare at you, just don't mind it.
If your twin flame is extinguished, play that harp concerto.
How the boat capsizes affects the smell of the cookies.

Do you believe it?
Are you redeemed?
Is it too sacrilegious to think of a frog as a priestess?

How do you imagine?
Do you understand?
At this moment, only delusions are singing and darling
You're not dancing.

The truth is ripples, distorted by pebbles.
For example, observers cannot measure the speed of light.
Or the meaning of life.
Every nonsense is a prelude to lies.
You were deceived; the floor was taken away.
You were seduced; the dart struck your fate.
Failures will be written. Mistakes will be engraved.
Only the aloof genius remem bers to save.

Do you believe it?
Are you redeemed?
Is it too sacrilegious to think of a frog as a priestess?

How do you imagine?
Do you understand?
At this moment, only delusions are singing and darling
You're not dancing.

When you read all the lyrics, please tell me what you think.
Does that sad hexagon trouble your breath?
If you are not stubborn, please share this story
with any anchovy named "Finn".

當水星逆行，請捕捉日落的景色。
知更鳥會凝視你，別在意它。
如果你的雙生火焰被熄滅，請彈奏那首豎琴協奏曲。
小船如何翻覆，會影響餅乾的氣味。

你是否相信？
你是否得到救贖？
把一隻青蛙視作女祭司是否太過褻瀆？

你如何想像？
你是否理解？
此刻只有妄想在高歌。還有，親愛的
你沒有在跳舞。

事實是漣漪，被鵝卵石扭曲。
舉個例子，觀測者無法測定光速。
或是生命的意義。
每一次胡言亂語皆是謊言的前奏。
你被欺騙；地面被奪走。
你被誘惑；飛鏢射中了你的命運。
失敗都會被寫下。錯誤都會被鐫刻。
只有孤高的天才忘記儲存。
